subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Character is a man without character. It hates as the crown of life. It also means psychological or ethical nature. Character of a is regarded the combination of some good qualities. person Everybody mental or moral qualities of a person.
guide_solution: (a) Character means mental or moral qualities of a person. (b) It is the combination of some good qualities. (c) It also means psychological or ethical nature. (d) Character of a person is regarded as the crown of life. (e) Everybody hates a man without character.
